headline: Selcuk Talay publicly recruits for his Apple PMU AMS design-verification team
fact: Apple posted a PMU Analog & Mixed-Signal Design Verification role for Cupertino and Austin covering full-chip mixed-signal verification, analog/RTL co-simulation, verification planning, assertions, coverage, and sign-off. Selcuk Talay publicly shared the role and described it as hiring for "my AMS design verification team," directly connecting him to the recruiting team.

sources.title: PMU Design Verification Engineer: Analog & Mixed Signal Engineer — Cupertino
sources.summary: Official Apple role 200658493 posted April 17, 2026 for Cupertino, with full-chip mixed-signal verification, analog/RTL co-simulation, planning, assertions, coverage, sign-off, and tape-out responsibilities.

sources.title: PMU Design Verification Engineer: Analog & Mixed Signal Engineer — Austin
sources.summary: Official Austin location variant of Apple role 200658493, posted April 17, 2026 with the same PMU analog and mixed-signal verification responsibilities.

sources.title: Selcuk Talay public Apple PMU AMS-DV hiring post
sources.summary: Talay's public post says he is hiring in Cupertino and Austin for his AMS design-verification team and links the Apple PMU Analog & Mixed Signal Engineer role.
